On a 3- year CAGR basis from FY24 to FY26, revenues have grown at 36% CAGR, EBITDA at 68% Bodhi Tree Multimedia Limited June 05, 2026 CAGR, and PAT at 50% CAGR .
The full -year picture of a INR118 crore revenue and INR17 crores EBITDA and an INR8 crores PAT is a true measure of FY26.
Growth & demand: Ad -supported AVOD, which is Advertising Video-on-Demand, FAST channels, YouTube -- these are creating entirely new economic models for content companies.
Now coming to the numbers, FY26 has been a year of consistent growth for us.
So, I think this year the revenue contribution would have been hardly 3-4% of the overall growth.
Margins & costs: EBITDA came in at INR17.1 crores, up 76% year -on-year, with margins expanding meaningfully to 14.44% from 10.78%.
The PAT stood at INR7.95 crores, up 62% year -on-year, with PAT margins at 6.71%.
EBITDA came in at INR5.96 crores, up 56% year-on-year, with EBITDA margins expanding to 16.52% from 9.73%, the highest margins of the year.
Capex & expansion: So, we completed the acquisition of 50.01% controlling stake in Moving Images Studios, led by Manisha Sharma, a veteran former Chief Content Officer at Viacom18 and veteran in the media and entertainment business.

On the IP transition, our revenue mix today stands at approximately 80% to 85% of commissioned content and 10% to 15% of IP-related revenues.
